notes: Hall 2: far-side soil. First, a common myth: the far side is not the dark side. It has day and night like the near side, and at new Moon it is fully lit. It simply always faces away from Earth, so we never see it from the ground. Chang'e-6 landed inside the South Pole–Aitken basin, the largest, deepest and oldest impact basin on the Moon, about 2,500 kilometres across. The first soft landing on the far side was Chang'e-4 in 2019. Chang'e-6 was the first mission to bring far-side soil home.
